name: Audiobookshelf
param_style: Sequelize v6 (sqlite3 driver): replacements and where values inlined as escaped literals (normalised here to :named params); instance save/create/update use $N bind parameters
schema_source: reconstructed from the Sequelize models in server/models/*.js (sync() output for the SQLite dialect) plus indexes from server/migrations and triggers from server/Database.js addTriggers(); only the tables the queries need
data_scale: scale 1: 2 libraries, 25 users, 12k books + 12k library items, 2.5k authors, 1.8k series, 6.6k bookSeries, 13.8k bookAuthors, 150 podcasts / 6k episodes, 13.6k mediaProgresses, 5k playback sessions
visibility_note: ~15k stars, the most widely self-hosted audiobook/podcast server; SQLite is its only database
interest_note: Library and home-shelf queries are Sequelize joins wrapped around raw literal fragments: correlated count subqueries (continue-series has four per series row), json_each tag/genre filters nested inside count subqueries, CAST(sequence AS FLOAT) NULLS LAST sort keys over through-table aliases, NOCASE sort indexes, and Sequelize's limited derived-table shape for required belongsToMany includes.
